newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK 364-day bills average accepted yield 5.22 pct.
newsitem.headline: HK 364-day bills average accepted yield 5.22 pct.

text.p: The average accepted yield of 364-day Exchange Fund bills at Tuesday's tender was 5.22 percent, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority said.
This compares with 12-month HIBOR of 6.06731 percent at 0300 GMT and an average accepted yield of 5.33 percent at the last monthly tender of one-year bills on October 29.
Bids for the HK$500 million issue rose to HK$3.49 billion from the previous HK$2.56 billion.
The average accepted yield of 91-day bills was 4.84 percent, compared with three-month HIBOR of 5.63462 percent and the average accepted yield of 4.90 percent at the previous tender on November 19.
Bids for the HK$2 billion issue were HK$8.67 billion against HK$9.82 billion at the last tender.
